notes:
Lead origin: inbound web form (signup for API trial) + replied to welcome email. Product fit: Embeddable ticket triage and summarization widget for SMB customers (help centers, small SaaS vendors).

Quick summary / requirement bullets:
- Wants Hosted API (self-serve) first; low friction onboarding most important.
- Primary flows: 1) automated ticket summarization (one-paragraph summary + action items), 2) structured JSON output with fields (priority, inferred category, suggested assignee), 3) tool-calling to open/update tickets via their existing Zendesk integration.
- Latency targets: median <600ms for short transforms (summary/labels), tail <1.5s under typical load.
- Throughput: baseline ~5-10 reqs/sec; burst to 40-50 for marketing spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Decision driver is token cost + per-request latency. Want to compare Redwood hosted token pricing vs alternatives.
- Model preferences: flexible. Prefer smaller cost-efficient models for summaries but want fallback to higher-quality model for complex tickets. Interested in model routing by cost/quality.
- SLOs/ops: need basic audit logs and request-level tracking for customer disputes. SSO not required for now but want workspace SSO in near term.
- Data handling: public cloud OK; want clear retention controls and opt-out for storing attachments.
